title: JupyterLab Math Notebook Tools
description: Settings for rendered notebook search, equation copy actions, and MathJax macros.

enableBoldVectorMacro.title: Bold vector macro
enableBoldVectorMacro.description: Render \vec{x} as \mathbf{x}. Custom macros below can override this preset.

mathMacros.title: MathJax macros
mathMacros.description: Global MathJax TeX macro definitions keyed by macro name. String values are used as direct replacements; array values can include a replacement and argument count.

renderedSearchDebounceMs.title: Rendered search debounce
renderedSearchDebounceMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before updating rendered notebook search highlights after typing.
